title: Nvidia Boss Admits to Affair With Suspected Chinese Spy
gist: CNAS video teaser (Vivek Chilukuri on 4News): Nvidia shares fell as much as 8% intraday after Jensen Huang admitted an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy, and per the New York Times Trump was briefed a year earlier but did nothing.

insights.claim: Nvidia shares fell as much as eight percent at one point after CEO Jensen Huang admitted having an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.
insights.speaker: CNAS
insights.so_what: Shows key-person/governance risk can move the largest AI-chip stock sharply intraday.
insights.quote: with shares in his company down eight percent at one point after he admitted having an affair with a woman suspected to be a Chinese spy

insights.claim: According to the New York Times, President Trump was briefed a year earlier that U.S. intelligence believed the woman was a Chinese operative, but did nothing about it.
insights.speaker: CNAS
insights.so_what: Raises political/investigative risk around administration chip-export decisions that benefited Nvidia's China sales.
insights.quote: President Trump was briefed a year ago that US intelligence believed she was a Chinese operative, but did nothing about it.

insights.claim: Jensen Huang had become a rock star of the tech world before the scandal, underscoring how much Nvidia's public image rested on its founder.
insights.speaker: CNAS
insights.so_what: Founder-centric valuation premium is vulnerable to founder-specific scandal.
insights.quote: In recent years Jensen Huang has become a rock star in the tech world.
